title: CPI-E1-P10C Phase 2 -- 42-event Reuters historical predictor evidence acquisition
scope_boundary: No Reuters-vs-Kalshi comparison, edge, PnL, fees, or after-cost economics calculated.
No Brier score, log loss, hit rate, or calibration calculated.
No event-level decision_cutoff invented; cutoff_semantics remains per_sibling_market.
Attempted all 42 frozen events; no event outside the frozen cohort acquired.

canonical_base.verified_via: git fetch + git ls-remote (not trusted from chat/doc text), re-verified a second time mid-task after a rate-limit interruption -- unchanged both times

phase1_manifest.verification: Independently re-read from origin/main, self-reported manifest_digest_sha256 field matches, event/sibling counts recomputed programmatically (42 events, 341 accepted_siblings), no event-level decision_cutoff field present anywhere in the manifest.

acquisition_procedure.summary: Fixed 3-rung fallback ladder (Rung 1: reuters.com direct; Rung 2: approved P10B-reviewed syndication host set with exact-release-date queries; Rung 3: Internet Archive Wayback/CDX lookup of the same host set), a fixed candidate admission filter (Reuters attribution, exact reference-month/year verified in body text, prospective/forecast tense, specific numeric headline-CPI-MoM value), and a >=2-independently-operated-host corroboration gate for PASS. Piloted on 4 events before being applied to the remaining 33; the >=2-host gate was explicitly confirmed unchanged after the pilot surfaced a single-host near-miss (KXCPI-24NOV).

p10b_reused_authority.validation_performed: Re-hashed all 7 P10B committed artifacts against manifest.json's declared sha256 values (all matched); re-ran scripts/validate_cpi_p10b_reuters_authority.py against current main (all 29 checks passed); confirmed all 5 P10B-sampled events fall inside the frozen 42-event cohort by event_ticker; confirmed P10B's admission filter and >=2-host corroboration standard is identical in substance to the Phase 2 v2 procedure (v2 was in fact modeled on it).

durable_raw_store.explanation: Same disclosed gap as P10B: no external durable archive/blob store is available to this working environment for third-party copyrighted Reuters wire content. Complete raw HTTP/Wayback-snapshot responses exist only in this session's local scratchpad, not committed to this repository.
durable_raw_store.assessment_of_committed_artifact_suffici: For the 2 new PASS events (CPI-23AUG, CPI-24JAN), every committed fact (Reuters attribution, datePublished, load-bearing sentence, its SHA-256) was independently re-derived by the acquiring session via a fresh, direct re-fetch of both corroborating hosts -- once via the Internet Archive Wayback Machine (an independent, publicly re-fetchable archival snapshot, not merely a live page that could change) and, for CPI-23AUG, once via a live direct fetch of kfgo.com -- before this receipt was written. This is stronger than the P10B precedent in one respect: the Wayback snapshot URLs are immutable and permanently re-fetchable by any independent reviewer, not subject to the live-page drift P10B disclosed for its own raw-hash values.
durable_raw_store.reviewer_verification_path: Re-fetch the exact Wayback snapshot URLs (and, for CPI-23AUG's kfgo.com fetch, the live URL) recorded in each event's fetches[] array; recompute the load-bearing-sentence SHA-256 and compare against load_bearing_sentence_sha256_cross_host; confirm datePublished and Reuters attribution in the page's own JSON-LD/meta fields.

search_execution_summary.rate_limit_interruption_disclosure: During execution, 3 of 6 parallel research batches (17 of the 42 events) were cut off mid-run by an Anthropic API session rate limit. Per explicit instruction, none of the incomplete/undocumented partial claims from that interruption (including a bare, evidence-free 'PASS' assertion for 2 events) were trusted or preserved -- canonical main and the frozen Phase 1 manifest were independently re-verified as unchanged, and all 17 affected events were re-run from a clean start under the identical frozen v2 procedure once the rate limit reset. No event was ever classified as a negative/UNKNOWN result merely because of the interruption.
